name: activity-entry
title: Activity entry
description: One activity as a sentence: who, what, which object and the from-to change, with a time and an icon.
docs: Put the entries in a ul. actor is { name, image, system }: a system actor, a bot or a job, has a square tile with the icon instead of an avatar. The sentence is the actor, the verb, the object (a link when it has an href, cut to one line with the full name in its title) and the change, drawn as two quiet chips around an arrow, with "from" and "to" for screen readers so the row reads as one string. The time reads 12 minutes ago, yesterday, 3 days ago and then the date, with the exact moment in its title; pass now to fix it. On a narrow row the time drops under the sentence.
